articles.title: Houston Astros put reliever Enyel De Los Santos on injured list, ending his regular season
articles.description: Enyel De Los Santos, who ranks ninth in the AL in innings among relievers, will miss the final eight games of the regular season with a knee injury.

articles.title: Houston Astros' offense stymied again as team falls into tie atop AL West following loss to Royals
articles.description: The Houston Astros offense, aside from Jeremy Peña, continued to struggle in loss to Royals and now the Rangers have caught the Astros for a tie atop the AL West.

articles.title: Taylor Trammell returns to Houston Astros from paternity list; Joey Loperfido back to Sugar Land
articles.description: After missing two games, Astros outfielder Taylor Trammell is back from the paternity list. Joey Loperfido is sent to Sugar Land.

articles.title: Alvarez hits 40th home run, Astros beat Royals 6-2 to move 1 game ahead of Rangers for AL West lead
articles.description: Yordan Alvarez hit his 40th home run, one of five Houston long balls, and the Astros beat the Kansas City Royals 6-2 to move back over .500 and maintain at least a share of the AL West lead.

articles.title: Houston Astros' go-to players power needed win over Kansas City Royals to start homestand
articles.description: Jeremy Peña homered twice and Yordan Alvarez also went deep to back Hunter Brown's start as Houston stayed atop the American League West with a homestand-opening win.

articles.title: Story behind John Lambert's Houston Astros flag he took to 100 countries before donating it to team
articles.description: John Lambert and his trusty Astros flag have seen some of the world's most famous places from the Eiffel Tower to the Egyptian pyramids. Now, the diehard fan has donated his flag to the team.
